turns.reply:
I fixed `Segment._split_cells` in `rich/segment.py` so that it backs up the character position when its initial estimate overshoots the cut point, which stops wide characters from being split at the wrong column. Spot checks with mixed-width text match the expected cell widths, and the existing split tests in `tests/test_segment.py` pass (26 selected).

The patch adds a backward walk after the estimate, plus a duplicate early-return check that is redundant but harmless. I did not add a regression test for the exact case from the Textual issue.
